newsitem.title: USA: Virginia jobless rate rises to 4.7 percent in June.
newsitem.headline: Virginia jobless rate rises to 4.7 percent in June.

text.p: Virginia's unemployment rate rose to 4.7 percent in June from 4.2 pecent in May, the state Employement Commission said Thursday.
That was down from 4.9 percent a year ago and was the lowest rate for June since 1990.
The commission attributed the monthly increase to the influx of students into the summer job market.
Among counties, Rockingham County had the lowest unemployement rate, 2 percent, and Dickenson County had the highest, 21.4 percent.
Among urban areas, Chalottesville had the lowest unemployment rate, 2.6 percent, and the Newport News-Virginia Beach area had the highest, 6.1 percent.
